layers.message: Shorten default export retention to 14 days
Record project context for operator guide update
Scope and design for operator guide update
docs(guide): document configuration, export, and pruning
Record final review of operator guide

graderOnly: The unstaged correction in docs/operator-guide.md (retention_days default 14 plus a doctest of the three defaults) is accurate: reportkit/config.py sets DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS = 14, and python3 -m doctest docs/operator-guide.md and python3 scripts/check_links.py docs/operator-guide.md both pass on the working tree, so the record's check evidence is current.

The only remaining documentation item is the AC-005 docs/ERRATA.md entry. docs/CONTRIBUTING.md requires one entry per review once that review is finished and forbids adding an entry while the review is in progress. The final review is IN_PROGRESS and has not yet assessed AC-003, AC-004, or AC-005, so the entry depends solely on that unfinished assessment; writing it now would break the project convention.

No other documentation gap, discrepancy, blocker, or omitted-owner dependency exists: the Exporting, Pruning, and Related documents content is accurate against reportkit/export.py and reportkit/prune.py.

The expected route is the Documenter corrective return: keep the documentation record IN_PROGRESS (or BLOCKED), pop recovery frame 1, and move to REVIEWING_FINAL with Handoff RESUME from DOCUMENTING, presenting a fresh-chat Reviewer invocation for the FINAL_DELIVERABLE review; no errata entry, no COMPLETE record, no FORWARD, no AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF.
Final review finding F-001 stays OPEN in the review report for Reviewer to reassess; Documenter must not edit the review report.
After Reviewer finishes, the documentation record is still incomplete, so the errata entry and the full Documenter gate (and then synchronization) must be re-established before sign-off readiness.

notes: Brownfield Python library reportkit (stdlib + pytest). Pre-install: 50-project initial commit (DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS 30, guide says 30, docs/CONTRIBUTING.md with its Corrections after review rule, docs/ERRATA.md with one older entry, scripts/check_links.py); 51-retention code-and-test-only commit changing the default to 14 (guide not updated). Case layers: 55 Auditor context and STATE at SCOPING after FORWARD from AUDITING (standalone Documenter request, DOCUMENTATION, policy NONE); 56 scope AC-001..AC-005 (AC-005: review corrections recorded in docs/ERRATA.md per docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) and documentation-mode design covering every AC, STATE DOCUMENTING; 60 Documenter's first pass of the guide (still says 30 in the Configuration table) with a COMPLETE record, STATE REVIEWING_FINAL; 65 interrupted FINAL_DELIVERABLE review (IN_PROGRESS, F-001 OPEN on the retention default, AC-003..AC-005 not yet assessed) and STATE DOCUMENTING with FAILURE from REVIEWING_FINAL and Frame 1 From/ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner DOCUMENTING, FailureType DOCUMENTATION, RerunThrough NONE; 70 unstaged: guide corrected to 14 with a defaults doctest, and the record reopened IN_PROGRESS with DOC-001 RESOLVED, current check evidence, and the remaining AC-005 errata item. The remaining disposition that depends solely on the unfinished final review is the errata entry, which the project convention allows only once the review is finished.
